_about: Fictional demo content for Fernway. The frontend's demo mode loads it into the browser, and the backend's seed script (python -m scripts.seed_demo) loads the same file. All companies, people and links are made up; .example addresses can't receive mail.

employers.name: Lumen Studio
employers.about: A twelve-person design studio in Nimman that builds brands, websites and apps for Thai hotels, cafés and social enterprises.

employers.name: Kinnari Health
employers.about: Kinnari Health makes the booking and reminder app used by 400 small clinics across Thailand, so patients can book a dentist or physio in a few taps.

employers.name: Ban Rai Coffee Co.
employers.about: A specialty coffee roaster working directly with hill-tribe farms in Chiang Rai, with four cafés in Chiang Mai and an online shop.

employers.name: Northgate Logistics
employers.about: Northgate runs next-day delivery for online shops in northern and central Thailand from three sorting hubs.

employers.name: Orchid Learning
employers.about: Orchid Learning makes English and coding courses for Thai high-school students, taught through short videos and weekly live classes.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.summary: Design booking flows and dashboards for hotel and café clients, from first research call to polished screens.
jobs.description:
You'll lead the design of two or three client products at a time, working with our developers and the client's team.

What you'll do
- Run short research sessions with guests and staff
- Turn messy workflows into simple screens in Figma
- Build and look after our shared design system
- Present your work to clients in Thai or English

What we're looking for
- About 3 or more years designing apps or websites
- A portfolio that shows how you got from problem to solution
- Comfortable with prototyping and usability testing

jobs.title: Brand & Visual Designer
jobs.summary: Create logos, packaging and social campaigns for local brands, working closely with our senior designers.
jobs.description:
Join a small team that cares about craft. You'll work on brand identities for cafés, guesthouses and craft makers, then bring them to life on packaging, menus and social media.

What you'll do
- Sketch and refine logo and identity concepts
- Design packaging, menus and print
- Make social media templates clients can reuse

What we're looking for
- A portfolio with branding or illustration work
- Good typography and an eye for detail
- Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, or Figma

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.summary: Build the booking screens and clinic dashboards that thousands of patients and receptionists use every day.
jobs.description:
Our web app is built with TypeScript and React. You'll own features from design handoff to release, and help keep the app fast and accessible on cheap phones.

What you'll do
- Build new booking and payment flows
- Improve performance and accessibility
- Review code and pair with other engineers

What we're looking for
- JavaScript or TypeScript, and a framework such as React or Vue
- Solid HTML and CSS
- For senior applicants: experience leading a feature end to end

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.summary: Design reliable APIs, calendar sync and the payment plumbing behind every clinic booking.
jobs.description:
We process about 30,000 bookings a day. You'll work on the Python services behind them, with a focus on reliability.

What you'll do
- Design and build APIs used by our apps and partners
- Make calendar sync and reminders dependable
- Improve monitoring and on-call tooling

What we're looking for
- Python, Go or Node.js in production
- SQL and PostgreSQL
- Experience with cloud hosting such as AWS

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.summary: Grow our online shop and subscription sales with email, social and a bit of paid advertising.
jobs.description:
Our online shop is growing fast and we need someone to own it. You'll plan campaigns, write emails and measure what works.

What you'll do
- Run our email newsletter and coffee subscription campaigns
- Plan social media content with our café team
- Test small paid ad budgets on Facebook and LINE
- Report on sales every month

What we're looking for
- Experience with email marketing or social media for a brand
- Comfortable with numbers and Google Analytics
- Thai and English writing

jobs.title: Café Operations Coordinator
jobs.summary: Keep our four cafés stocked and staffed: rotas, supplier orders and opening checklists.
jobs.description:
You'll be the person the café managers call when something runs out. Most of your week is spent between our roastery and the cafés.

What you'll do
- Plan staff rotas across four cafés
- Order milk, cups and supplies, and track stock
- Keep opening and closing checklists up to date

What we're looking for
- Experience in hospitality, retail or operations
- Organised and calm under pressure
- Spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)

jobs.title: Social Media Content Intern
jobs.summary: Shoot and edit short videos about our farms, roasting and cafés for TikTok and Instagram.
jobs.description:
A four-month internship for a student who loves making short videos. You'll visit our partner farms and learn how a small brand plans content.

What you'll do
- Film and edit short videos with your phone
- Help write captions in Thai and English
- Track which posts do well

What we're looking for
- A few videos you've made (school projects are fine)
- CapCut, Premiere or similar
- Available for at least four months

jobs.title: People & Operations Coordinator
jobs.summary: Run hiring, onboarding and training for the 200 drivers and sorters at our Bangkok hub.
jobs.description:
We hire 20 to 30 people a month. You'll keep that process organised and make sure every new starter has a good first week.

What you'll do
- Schedule interviews and send offers
- Run onboarding and safety training
- Keep staff records and contracts in order

What we're looking for
- Experience in recruiting, HR or operations
- Clear communication in Thai, with basic English
- Tools like Google Workspace, Notion or an HR system

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.summary: Find out why parcels arrive late, and build the dashboards our hub managers check every morning.
jobs.description:
We have lots of delivery data and too few people looking at it. You'll answer questions for the operations team and turn the useful answers into dashboards.

What you'll do
- Write SQL to explore delivery and route data
- Build dashboards in Looker Studio or Power BI
- Present findings to hub managers

What we're looking for
- SQL and Excel or Google Sheets
- Some Python or R is a plus
- Able to explain numbers in plain language

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
jobs.summary: Pair with a mentor and ship real features for our course website from your second week.
jobs.description:
A six-month paid internship for students. You'll work on our course website and the tools teachers use to run live classes.

What you'll do
- Fix bugs and build small features with a mentor
- Write tests and review each other's code
- Join a weekly demo with the whole team

What we're looking for
- You've built something with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, or Python
- Git basics
- Curious and happy to ask questions

jobs.title: Student Support Specialist
jobs.summary: Answer questions from students and parents on LINE and email, 20 hours a week, mostly evenings.
jobs.description:
Help students get the most out of their courses. Most questions are about logging in, schedules and payments.

What you'll do
- Reply to messages on LINE and email
- Write help articles for common questions
- Pass bugs to the engineering team

What we're looking for
- Friendly, clear writing in Thai and English
- Patient with people who are new to technology
- Available four evenings a week

profile.headline: Frontend engineer, React and accessibility
